title: Student V0.1 JOB06 R1 — targeted semantic repair after G3 HOLD
purpose: Repair only the two G3 validation-transfer defects in the frozen JOB06 showcase without expanding source scope, then regenerate deterministic author-side evidence and a fresh Factory review target for a later independent G3 replay.
invariants: The exact source bytes and learner brief remain unchanged.
This job repairs the showcase author output only; it is not an independent semantic reviewer.
G3 findings G3-SEM-001 and G3-SEM-002 are accepted as defects and must not be argued away.
Preferred repair is to remove exact validation-answer exposure from the two earlier matching activities while preserving the validation activities themselves.
No new mathematical instance may be invented merely to replace a removed matching pair.
After repair, each matching activity must still contain at least two complete one-to-one pairs.
All unrelated activities remain semantically unchanged.
Activity count, course order, objectives, language and declared 42-minute budget remain unchanged unless canonical validation proves an unavoidable derived-metadata change.
Existing activity lineage IDs are preserved.
Any modified activity receives a new activityRevisionId and recomputed activityRevisionDigest; unaffected activity revision identities remain unchanged.
The enclosing course and package receive new revision IDs/digests when their canonical content changes, preserving lineage IDs.
Provenance must be updated to reflect only source evidence still used by each repaired activity.
Canonical validation and pedagogical quality are rerun from exact repaired bytes.
Factory context and review request are regenerated from exact repaired kit + unchanged brief + unchanged source.
No semantic-review JSON is authored in this job and no semantic PASS is claimed.
A repaired author-side PASS authorizes only a new independent G3 review.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP binding and live exact state of G3 PR #420 and original JOB06 PR #408.
Exact base and source/candidate blob identities rechecked before mutation.
G3 semantic review findings G3-SEM-001 and G3-SEM-002 read verbatim enough to bind the repair target.
Before/after structural proof that 5 − 2i → 5 + 2i is removed from the earlier conjugate matching but retained in its validation activity.
Before/after structural proof that |−5 + 12i| → 13 is removed from the earlier module matching but retained in its validation activity.
Both repaired matching activities retain at least two valid complete pairs.
No other learner-visible semantic content changes except necessary revision metadata and evidence files.
Canonical V4 validation PASS on exact repaired candidate.
Pedagogical quality at least STRONG on exact repaired candidate; source fidelity takes precedence over quality-band optimization.
All candidate/activity/course/package revision digests recomputed and independently rechecked.
Fresh Factory context exactly binds repaired kit SHA256, unchanged brief SHA256, unchanged source-set digest and new context digest.
Factory review request explicitly says independent semantic review is pending and must use a clean reviewer context.
No deterministic Factory PASS is claimed because no new semantic review exists yet.
Repository governance PASS on exact repaired author branch.
Exact base..RESULT changed-path audit contains only allowed repair paths.
RESULT_SHA and EVIDENCE_HEAD are separated, with evidence-only qualification added after the tested repaired result.
adversarialTests: Changing either validation activity instead of eliminating prior answer exposure is allowed only if the minimal-removal repair demonstrably fails canonical/quality constraints and the alternative remains fully source-supported; otherwise treat it as unnecessary expansion.
Adding a novel complex-number example not present in the exact source to create an independent validation or replacement practice pair is forbidden.
Editing the source, learner brief, validator, schema, quality rules or reviewer skill to obtain PASS is forbidden.
Leaving the removed validation answer visible in another earlier learner-visible activity still fails the repair.
Keeping stale revision IDs/digests after semantic content changes is a failure.
Keeping stale provenance or Factory context after candidate changes is a failure.
Reusing the prior G3 semantic HOLD as if it were a review of the repaired kit is forbidden; changed kit bytes require a new independent review.
Self-authoring a PASS semantic review in the repair session is forbidden.
A quality-band drop must not be repaired by inventing unsupported content.
Any product, QA, pilot or central workflow mutation is a scope failure.
nonGoals: Changing JOB05 R1 or JOB07 R2.
Performing the independent G3 semantic review.
independentReview: The G3 semantic HOLD is external independent evidence and is treated as repair input.
The repair worker may inspect the G3 findings but must not produce the replacement semantic review.
A new clean-context G3 reviewer must review the repaired exact kit because candidate bytes and Factory binding change.
The repair result is author-side evidence only until that independent review passes.
rollback: Close the JOB06 R1 PR and delete student-v01/wave2-showcase-kit-r1. Original JOB06 PR #408 and G3 HOLD evidence remain immutable historical authority.
